semantic_contract.task_statement: Return the maximum value in every sliding window.

result.canonical_semantics: Maximum value from each contiguous sliding window.

semantic_contract.human_review_instruction: Judge the original generated pseudocode against this same frozen task-semantic contract, including when automated evaluation is NOT_EVALUABLE.

declared_evidence_summary: This suite evaluates sliding-window maxima for a representative case, k=1, k equal to the array length, and a negative-only array. Invalid window sizes are evaluated separately as semantic-boundary probes.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on 4 core Common Test cases plus any separately declared semantic-boundary probes; boundary probes do not contribute to core behavioural accuracy.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret core behavioural accuracy as evidence within the frozen semantic contract. Interpret Semantic Boundary Variance separately as descriptive evidence of out-of-domain acceptance.
coverage_limitations: Window sizes <=0 and window sizes larger than the array are outside the valid sliding-window relation and are measured separately as semantic-boundary probes.
